fields.label: Enable eCourts Sync
fields.description: Runs the hourly CNR auto-poll for matters marked for auto-sync.

fields.label: eCourts API URL
fields.description: Defaults to the eCourts NJDG case-status endpoint.

fields.label: eCourts App Code
fields.description: App code issued by the eCourts portal (services.ecourts.gov.in) for CNR status lookups.

fields.label: eCourts Order Sheet URL
fields.description: Optional endpoint for order-sheet history. When set, sync also fetches order sheet entries and posts them to the timeline.

fields.label: Enable Portal Sync (IP India / NCLT / RERA)
fields.description: Runs the hourly poll for matters marked with a non-eCourts portal. Portals without a machine API fall back to manual entry with coverage notes.

fields.label: Enable Hearing Reminders
fields.description: Daily job emails the assigned advocate before upcoming chamber hearings.

fields.label: Reminder Recipient Role
fields.description: All users with this role receive hearing reminders (in addition to the assigned advocate).

fields.label: Enable E-Signature Flow
fields.description: Sends generated documents for signature and tracks status via webhooks.

fields.label: Provider
fields.options:
DocuSign
Dropbox Sign
SignDesk
eMudhra
Generic REST
Manual

fields.label: API URL
fields.description: POST endpoint that creates the signing envelope. See README for the expected request/response contract.

fields.label: Callback Secret
fields.description: Optional shared secret the provider must send back for webhook verification.

fields.label: AI Provider
fields.options:
OpenAI
OpenAI Compatible
Azure OpenAI
Anthropic
fields.description: OpenAI Compatible covers local/self-hosted endpoints (Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, etc.)

fields.label: Require Lawyer Review for Sensitive Matters
fields.description: DV / 498A / adoption AI drafts are always flagged for mandatory lawyer review.
